title: Grateful Dead Live at Carousel Ballroom on 1968-02-14
lineage: 1st generation reels (Technics RS-1506) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz) > dBpoweramp .wav 24/96 > Adobe Audition CC 2024 > flac2496
taper: Matt Smith for the 1st generation reel source
source: FM Broadcast > Master Reels > Matt Smith's 1st generation reels

ai_review.summary: Open, clear FM mix captures the legendary second set from Feb 14 1968 with standout Pigpen organ work; despite a mis‑dated label, reviewers hail the performance as red‑hot and essential.
ai_review.review: Reviewers praise this recording for its unusually open mix that lets Pigpen’s organ shine, noting the sound is crisp and well‑balanced. The second set—featuring The Other One, New Potato Caboose, Born Cross‑Eyed, Spanish Jam, Alligator, Caution (Do Not Stop On Tracks), Feedback and In The Midnight Hour—is described as a “red‑hot” highlight of a great show, even though the date tag was initially wrong.

ai_rating.rationale: Two detailed reviews praise both the musical performance (highly regarded set) and recording quality (open mix, clear organ), yielding a strong combined rating despite limited review count.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mix described as more open than usual; Pigpen’s organ parts are clearly audible and exceptional. No mention of dropouts or major flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set is considered the highlight of the night, matching the famed Feb 14/Jan 14 1968 set; reviewers note it’s half of a great show and flows powerfully.

band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen's organ is audible and praised as exceptional, something later keyboard players did not attempt in Dark Stars.
